content_preview.summary: A Google engineer's commit adds an experimental enable_flatpak build flag to Chromium's Linux installer code, explicitly not a commitment to official Flatpak support.

## Overview

Chromium's build system now has experimental support for packaging the browser as a Flatpak. A commit from Google engineer Tom Anderson, merged into the Chromium source tree on August 25, 2026, adds an `enable_flatpak` build flag to the project's Linux installer code, according to the [commit itself on GitHub](https://github.com/chromium/chromium/commit/70c9e8f351f353dfbef882c784668f4176e3d9ae).
